name: Agent manager
author: Brett
description: Create, edit, manage and orchestrate AI agents built from personas, lingo, skills and tools, each with its own persistent memory. Wizards for agents, skills, tools, an all-in-one agent builder and training (Firecrawl, web pages, the repo, MCP). Add-on agents: Mosses (React/TS/Python coder with container write mode), AXF expert, AI expert. Agents follow the framework contract agent-definition@1, so other AXF apps load the same ones. Works with the AI assistant when both are installed.

items.title: Who has API control
items.description: Every employee (Amber = the AI assistant, the agents, the crew) and whether it may drive the console through its API, with its scopes and last change. Amber and Molly are on by default, everyone else off. Say 'who has API control'.

items.title: An agent's API control
items.description: One employee's API control grant, scopes and its last 20 changes. Say 'does Rio have API control'.

aid.description: agent id: amber (the AI assistant), an Agent manager agent (molly, coder, …) or a crew member (rio, kat, …)

items.title: Give or take API control
items.description: Switch an employee's console API control on or off and pick its scopes (audited, shows on the employee card). Say 'give Rio API control for screens and settings' or 'take API control from Molly'.

aid.description: agent id: amber (the AI assistant), an Agent manager agent (molly, coder, …) or a crew member (rio, kat, …)

scopes.description: what API control covers: screens (open screens), settings (change settings), commands (run commands), builds (file/queue builds); leave out for all

items.title: Reset API control to default
items.description: Put an employee back to the default (Amber and Molly on, everyone else off). Audited.

aid.description: agent id: amber (the AI assistant), an Agent manager agent (molly, coder, …) or a crew member (rio, kat, …)

items.title: API control changes
items.description: The audit of API control changes: who changed whose, from what to what, when and why. Optional agent filter.

items.title: Open API control
items.description: Open the Agent manager's API control tab in the open console, on one employee. args: [agentId].
